name: @pdf-studio/desktop-windows
description: PDF Studio Beta — Editor e Leitor de PDF Desktop para Windows (Cult UI Edition)
author: PDF Studio

scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main
scripts.pack:win: npm run build && npm run prepare:electron && electron-builder --win dir --config electron-builder.json
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run prepare:electron && electron-builder --win nsis portable --config electron-builder.json
scripts.dist:win:beta: npm run build && npm run prepare:electron:beta && electron-builder --win nsis portable --config electron-builder.beta.json
